opening.quote: Good morning, tidal Home, by name is femme. How can I help
opening.comment: You gave your name and a greeting, but the company name was garbled as 'tidal Home' and the name as 'femme'; speak clearly so the caller hears 'Tidewell Home' and your name.

verification.quote: Could take you're full name and the order number postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for full name and order number or postcode before looking up the order, which is correct, and the caller provided both.

understanding.quote: So you opened dispute with your bank about this payment?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue as a bank dispute and did not re-ask for information already given, though the opening exchange was hard to follow.

resolution_accuracy.quote: reply to you by so email within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The Payments team replies within 2 working days, not 3, so the timeline you quoted was wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Bank disputes are handl by our paymentss team, so I've passed you case to them with all details.
process_compliance.comment: Correctly passing the bank dispute to the Payments team without handling it is the required step.

communication.quote: hokay, as long as someones gets back to be.
communication.comment: The caller said they were not happy and you did not acknowledge their frustration, so add an apology or empathy line when a caller is upset.

closing.quote: Is they're anything else I can hell you with?
closing.comment: You asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but you should also restate clearly what happens next (Payments reply and case reference email).
